interpretation.reason: COMPILED improves aggregate selection and exact-reduction cases, but all nine semantic wins are concentrated in two development cases requiring duplicate-aware quorum reduction and arithmetic aggregation. The two exact-reduction holdouts and every reconciliation case are already RAW ceiling. Responsibility type alone therefore does not predict externalization value.
interpretation.strongerCandidate: Externalization value appears thresholded by repeated mechanical burden/complexity relative to model reliability, not by a binary cognitive-versus-substrate category. Future-model-robust responsibility is necessary for safe placement but not sufficient for useful externalization.
interpretation.costObservation: COMPILED also uses fewer Provider tokens overall (56,169 versus 58,604; about 4.2% less), but token savings without semantic gain do not independently earn a durable abstraction.
interpretation.nextFalsifier: Do not lengthen synthetic raw packets to manufacture difficulty. Reopen this mechanism on natural workloads where raw reconstruction already shows measurable error or recurring cost, and test whether the smallest owner-native projection removes that observed burden.

claimBoundary: Eight Computing-local synthetic-but-Ordivon-grounded operational cases, two DeepSeek model families and three replicas. F10A provides scoped evidence for complexity-dependent deterministic externalization, not a general PAL responsibility-placement law and not an owner reform authorization.
